item.title: US reaches 1st Olympic curling mixed doubles final, facing Sweden for gold
item.description: Korey Dropkin and Cory Thiesse guaranteed the U.S. its first Olympic medal in mixed doubles curling, reaching the final Monday with a 9-8 victory over Italy.
